Official PM transcript dated21Oct2026 matches the sentence, restores proposed-register/people-described-as-violent context; Bank of Albania independently confirms meeting participation/date.
limitations: Political labels about confusion or remaining in power are satire/opinion, not a diagnosis or verified private motive.
The speech establishes the stated proposal and target; it does not independently establish allegations about violence, a final legal instrument, enactment or an individual travel ban.
No claim that all critics or peaceful protesters are already barred; no invented train-service, legal-outcome or ancient-ancestry finding.
